objective: Construction and proof. A simple Mal'tsev algebra on five values containing Z4 composes like cycles, and ticket B of RIGID-SELECTION, placed inside it, keeps knots in its top: the conjecture fails as stated. The correct statement concerns layers of abelian sections: when the sections of a failing system come from one chain ring, every kept knot has at most one variable reaching the top of that ring (RIGID-SELECTION D through a common model). With ticket C: a law that composes like cycles keeps emergence inside a selected space only through a two-layer abelian section (at least four values), and below that section's top; the knot keeps emergence at two values, in its only layer.
